text:
QUINCE:
  Here's the list with every man's name on it.
  These are the men all of Athens thinks are fit to act in our play.
  We'll put it on for the Duke and Duchess on the night of his wedding.
BOTTOM:
  First, good Peter Quince, tell us what the play's about.
  Then read out the names of the actors, and work your way up to the point.
QUINCE:
  Well, our play is The Most Lamentable Comedy and Most Cruel Death of Pyramus and Thisbe.
